# Copilot Skills Directory

This directory is reserved for Copilot/agent skills wrappers.

- Place skill wrappers (SKILL.md) for workflows and features here, mirroring the structure in agent-rules/workflows/.
- Each skill should reference the corresponding rule in ../agent-rules/.
- Example: commit-msg/SKILL.md, design-implementation/SKILL.md, etc.

See native-toolkit for structure reference.
